target: true-negative: an exact-case needle must still match, or the tightening is just a wall
cmd:
mkdir -p c/syn
cat > c/syn/s.json <<'CASEEOF'
{"id": "syn-5", "kind": "bash-unit", "target": "synthetic", "checks": [{"type": "must_find", "strings": ["EXACT"]}], "cmd": "echo an EXACT match"}
CASEEOF
EVAL_CASES_DIR="$PWD/c" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/evals/run_eval.sh" --suite syn >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{"code":%s}' $?
